source.stem:
A person measures the length, width, height and mass of a metal block with rectangular sides.
Which of these measurements must be used in order to calculate the density of the metal?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Gravity is a contact force because the object has to be on Earth.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Contact may be direct or indirect through another object.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: contact-force classification; ability to act without contact -> non-contact-forc happens first, and that produces need for physical contact.

mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when Contact may be direct or indirect through another object is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: Contact forces need physical contact between objects, while non-contact forces can be experienced even when the objects are not in contact. Muscular force and friction are contact forces; magnetic, electrostatic, and gravitational forces are non-contact forces. need for physical contact -> contact-force classification; ability to act without contact -> non-contact-force classification The learner correctly applies this rule: Contact forces need physical contact between objects, while non-contact forces can be experienced even when the objects are not in contact. Muscular force and friction are contact forces; magnetic, electrostatic, and gravitational forces are non-contact forces. Contact force means a person touches the object, and non-contact force means no force is really present.
